scope.model: ASTRA Qwen3.8 Flash-Next IQ2_XS / Strata 0.1.41 MTP4
scope.workload: two synthetic read-only marker tasks per seed in isolated Git worktrees

decision: Do not adopt two-worker fan-out for this ASTRA configuration. Keep exact-label workloads serial until a material change fixes and revalidates final-answer association. The subagents returned the assigned markers, while two parallel parent answers swapped ALPHA/BETA labels. Raw marker task throughput was 5.11% lower in parallel, and correctly completed E2E task throughput was 68.37% lower.
memoryConclusion: Observed behavior matches policy: PSI moderate enough to warn, but global full below the 60% severe threshold, available memory above the 32 GiB hard floor, and OOM counters unchanged, so the guard continued. CPU replays confirm warning-only moderate PSI, 15-consecutive-sample severe stop, recovery reset, and historical Q91/Q93 trace behavior. Historical ASTRA DEFAULT 1M Q14/Q35 and SOL dual-GPU Q34 remain intact; Q100 itself ran at 64K, not 1M.

validation.q100CppTarget: 7 PASS, 0 FAIL, 1 opt-in live slot skipped

limitations: Small synthetic workload and three seeds; result is specific to this model/runtime/prompt/configuration, not a universal claim about all fan-out.
Q100 used 64K context; it does not repeat the 1M context workload.
No production app build or profile change was made.
